questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What is Amazon Comprehend used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: A natural-language-processing (NLP) service: sentiment analysis, entity recognition, key-phrases, language detection, PII detection, custom classification and custom entity recognition.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "A natural-language-processing (NLP) service: sentiment analysis, entity recognition, key-phrases, language detection, PII detection, custom classification and custom entity recognition."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Amazon Comprehend

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What is Amazon Translate used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Neural machine translation service — translates text between languages.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "Neural machine translation service — translates text between languages."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Amazon Translate

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What is Amazon Transcribe used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Speech-to-text service: converts audio into text (supports streaming & batch).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "Speech-to-text service: converts audio into text (supports streaming & batch)."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Amazon Transcribe

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What is Amazon Polly used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Text-to-speech service: convert text into spoken audio in multiple languages/voices.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "Text-to-speech service: convert text into spoken audio in multiple languages/voices."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Amazon Polly

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What is Amazon Rekognition used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Image and video analysis service: object/scene detection, face detection/recognition, text in images, celebrity recognition, video analysis, etc.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "Image and video analysis service: object/scene detection, face detection/recognition, text in images, celebrity recognition, video analysis, etc."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Amazon Rekognition

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What is Amazon Lex used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Conversational AI service: build conversational bots/chatbots (text or voice) using automatic speech recognition + NLP + dialogue management.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "Conversational AI service: build conversational bots/chatbots (text or voice) using automatic speech recognition + NLP + dialogue management."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Amazon Lex

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What is Amazon Personalize used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Real-time personalization & recommendation engine: you provide user/item interaction data, Personalize builds models and serves recommendations.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "Real-time personalization & recommendation engine: you provide user/item interaction data, Personalize builds models and serves recommendations."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Amazon Personalize

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What is Amazon Textract used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Document understanding service: extracts text, forms, tables, and handwritten text from scanned documents (images or PDFs).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "Document understanding service: extracts text, forms, tables, and handwritten text from scanned documents (images or PDFs)."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Amazon Textract

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What is Amazon Kendra used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Intelligent enterprise search service using ML: lets you build a search index across various data sources (S3, SharePoint, databases etc) with semantic search, ranking, relevance tuning.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "Intelligent enterprise search service using ML: lets you build a search index across various data sources (S3, SharePoint, databases etc) with semantic search, ranking, relevance tuning."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Amazon Kendra

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What is Amazon Augmented AI (A2I) used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) service: you integrate ML services (Textract, Rekognition, etc) and when model confidence is below threshold you route to human reviewers via A2I workflow, track review, feed results back into ML.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "Human-in-the-loop (HITL) service: you integrate ML services (Textract, Rekognition, etc) and when model confidence is below threshold you route to human reviewers via A2I workflow, track review, feed results back into ML."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Amazon Augmented AI (A2I)

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are AWS Trainium and Inferentia (Hardware AI) used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: AWS provides specialized compute hardware for ML training/inference (e.g., GPU/Accelerator EC2 instances, AWS Trainium/Inferentia chips) rather than a fully managed higher-level AI service.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "AWS provides specialized compute hardware for ML training/inference (e.g., GPU/Accelerator EC2 instances, AWS Trainium/Inferentia chips) rather than a fully managed higher-level AI service."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: AWS Trainium and Inferentia (Hardware AI)

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What is Amazon Lookout for Metrics used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Anomaly-detection services — you feed time-series or sensor/event data and the service finds anomalies (e.g., unusual behaviour) with minimal ML expertise required.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "Anomaly-detection services — you feed time-series or sensor/event data and the service finds anomalies (e.g., unusual behaviour) with minimal ML expertise required."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Amazon Lookout for Metrics

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What is Amazon Fraud Detector used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Service for building fraud detection (payments, identities, accounts) using machine learning. It provides features, variable selection, model building, scoring, and deployment for fraud use cases.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "Service for building fraud detection (payments, identities, accounts) using machine learning. It provides features, variable selection, model building, scoring, and deployment for fraud use cases."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Amazon Fraud Detector

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What is Amazon Q (Q-Business, Q-Apps, Q-Developer) used for?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Q-Business: LLM-powered analytics on business data (insights, dashboards, etc). Q-Apps: Build conversational or agent-type applications quickly using LLM backend. Q-Developer: Provide developers more control/integration to build custom LLM-based applications or fine-tune models.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: The following describes which service? "Q-Business: LLM-powered analytics on business data (insights, dashboards, etc). Q-Apps: Build conversational or agent-type applications quickly using LLM backend. Q-Developer: Provide developers more control/integration to build custom LLM-based applications or fine-tune models."
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Amazon Q (Q-Business, Q-Apps, Q-Developer)
